entities.summary: Austria has been represented at the Eurovision Song Contest 57 times since its debut in 1957. The country has won three times, in 1966, 2014 and 2025. The Austrian participating broadcaster in the contest is Österreichischer Rundfunk (ORF). Vienna was the host city on both occasions the contest has been held in Austria, in 1967 and 2015, and the capital will host the event for a third time in 2026.
